    How this estimate works

    Actual Miami-Dade street centerlines, synthetic demand and road costs. Drivers choose their fastest route until the network reaches equilibrium. Every street is treated as two-way; a closure removes both modeled directions. Colors show modeled flow relative to assumed capacity, not live traffic.

    Neighborhood boundaries limit detours. Real one-way rules, turn restrictions, traffic signals, queues and trip demand are not calibrated. A benefit here demonstrates the model, not a recommendation to close a Miami street.
